description: Run the same task as the public Research Desk and REST API. Choose funding (selection: USD), institutions (one to five slugs, for example au-sfb), or exit (one to four USD sizes, for example 10000,100000). Empty selection uses the published default. Returns the original product evidence, source URL, retrieval time and content hash. prepared_response means evidence is available to review, not freshness, safety or task completion. No account or execution authority.
name: financial_evidence_workflow
